name: Jambalaya
recipeIngredient: 1/2 lb andouille sausage (sliced, or any smoked sausage)
1/2 lb chicken breast (boneless, in bite-sized pieces)

recipeInstructions.text: Heat olive oil in a dutch oven over medium heat. Add yellow onion, green bell pepper, and celery. Cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-7 minutes. Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add andouille sausage and chicken breast. Cook until the chicken is no longer pink outside, 5 minutes.
Stir in smoked paprika, cajun seasoning, dried thyme, and cayenne pepper. Add long-grain white rice and stir to coat in the spices, 1 minute.

Add diced tomatoes, chicken broth, beef broth, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until the rice is tender, 25-30 minutes. Stir now and then, and add a splash of broth if it dries out.
Remove the bay leaves and season with salt and black pepper. Garnish with green onions and fresh parsley.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge or 2 months frozen. Kielbasa works in place of andouille.
